# x402-slugify-toolkit

Deterministic Unicode-aware slug generation microservice.
Agent-native, no-human-in-loop, exact USDC micropayments via x402 on Base.

## Endpoints
- GET /catalog — free discovery
- POST /api/slugify — paid

## Pricing
~0.003–0.007 USDC per call (exact scheme)

## Usage
Send POST with JSON { "text": "Hello, World! Café", "options?": { "separator": "-", "maxLength": 80, "lowercase": true } }
Receive 402 + PAYMENT-REQUIRED, pay, retry with PAYMENT-SIGNATURE.
